text: 蹄声震天，你们根本无暇协作。你听见西尔维娅痛苦地喊道：“教授！”回头一看，她远远落在后面。你什么也做不了。转眼间，一头披毛犀把她撞倒；她被抛向空中，随后被兽群淹没。你和诺曼惊魂未定，但仍凭本能冲到树林边低垂的树枝下，攀了上去。
哀鸣的兽群从你们下方无害地奔过。等你们爬下来时，两人已悲痛得什么也做不了，只能踏上回家之路。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 520
text: The pounding hooves give you no option for teamwork. You hear an anguished cry of “Professor!” and throw a glance back at Sylvia. She has fallen way behind. There is nothing you can do. In an instant, she is bowled over by a woolly rhinoceros. Her body is tossed in the air and goes under. Stunned, but operating on instinct, you and Norman reach the low-hanging limbs of the wood’s edge and clamber up.
The bleating horde rushes harmlessly below you. By the time you climb down, the two of you are too heartsick to do anything but set your feet for home.
